approval_name: Form BRL Licence — Constructing and Working a Brewery for Manufacture of Beer
why_required: Statutory licence required under Rule 3(2) of the Maharashtra Manufacture of Beer and Wine Rules, 1966 to construct and operate a brewery manufacturing beer.
prerequisites: MPCB Consent to Establish (letter-of-intent stage); MPCB Consent to Operate (licence stage); Fire NOC (stage unspecified)
notes:
Core approval. Checklist page reconciles with an older 2014-reviewed page — see SRC-001 staleness flag.
Applies to any person/entity proposing to construct and work a standalone brewery for manufacture of beer in Maharashtra. Does NOT cover the separate BRL microbrewery (restaurant-based) licence — not modeled in this dataset.
time_source_note: No statutory processing time published on the retrieved source. Treat as unknown until the Excise department confirms an SLA.
cost_source_note: Application-fee challan is required (DOC-001) and a bank guarantee of 50% of the licence fee (DOC-009), but the fee schedule was not captured by the retrieved source — needs departmental confirmation.

approval_name: FSSAI Food Business Licence or Registration
why_required: Beer manufacturing is treated as a food business activity under FSSAI's Food Safety and Standards (Alcoholic Beverages) Regulations, 2018.
applicability_conditions: Applies to any food business operator manufacturing alcoholic beverages including beer. Exact licence level (central/state) and document checklist depend on production capacity/turnover/business structure not yet in the BusinessProfile — treat as needs_information until known.
parallelizable: yes — independent regulatory track from Excise/MPCB/Fire/DISH
renewal: yes — FSSAI licences are renewed periodically per standard practice; exact period not confirmed in this pass
notes: See also SRC-007 for the Alcoholic Beverages Regulations, 2018 reference.
time_source_note: FoSCoS does not publish a fixed processing SLA on the retrieved page.
cost_source_note: FoSCoS published fee schedule by licence level (State ₹2000/₹3000/₹5000; Central ₹5000); the ₹2000–7500 range spans State-to-Central licence levels.
